summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Sistema de Socio Gestor features. All 15 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI testing verified Admin Panel Socios tab, Gestor Dashboard with both balances, 4-step transaction flow, and role-specific menu navigation.
critical_code_review_comments: Implementation follows the requirements correctly with separated balances (balance_ris and balance_ris_terceros)
Admin panel properly displays both Socios Referidos and Socios Gestores in the Partners tab
Gestor dashboard correctly fetches and displays balance_ris_terceros from the API
Role-specific menu items correctly appear based on user role (socio, socio_gestor, admin)
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_Beneficiario PM and TEST_Beneficiario TR beneficiaries during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sistema de Socio Gestor fully tested. Key features verified: (1) Admin /api/admin/partners and /api/admin/gestors endpoints return correct data with balance_ris_terceros, (2) Gestor /api/gestor/dashboard returns both balance_ris and balance_ris_terceros, (3) Beneficiaries support both payment_type: pago_movil and transferencia, (4) Transaction flow uses balance_ris_terceros for third-party remittances, (5) Menu shows role-specific links (Socio, Gestor, Admin)

admin_partners_endpoint.notes: Returns list of socios with referral stats

gestor_recharge_terceros.notes: Validates amount and transfers from personal to terceros balance

admin_panel_socios_tab.notes: Shows Socios Referidos and Socios Gestores sub-tabs with data

gestor_dashboard_ui.notes: Displays Mi Saldo Personal and Saldo Terceros cards

role_specific_menu.notes: Menu shows Socio link for socio/socio_gestor, Gestor link for socio_gestor, Admin for admin/super_admin

transaction_4_step_flow.notes: 4-step modal: Amount -> Payment Type -> Client+Beneficiary -> Confirm

tests_performed.test: GET /api/admin/gestors returns gestor list with balance_ris_terceros
Admin Panel Socios tab displays partners/gestores
